officials.title: Receiver of Taxes
officials.notes: VACANT. Erica Winter, elected November 2025, resigned September 2026 after accepting a position that did not allow her to hold public office. Under Town Law the Deputy Receiver assumes all duties automatically until someone is appointed or elected. No appointment was made at the September 14 2026 meeting; the board is weighing appointment against a referendum to make the office appointed rather than elected, with full discussion set for October 2026.
